about: eGFR equations from the R packages egfr (full precision) and kidney.epi (rounded to two decimals by the package; its bedside Schwartz is equation_type 'classic', 0.413 x height / creatinine) on a grid of creatinine (mg/dl), age (whole years) and sex, for comparison with src/core/domains/nephrology/egfr/formulas.ts. CKD-EPI 2009 and MDRD without the race coefficient; MDRD with the IDMS-traceable constant 175. Research use only.
